description: Today's complete picture: calorie/macro totals vs targets, water, streak, exercises, and the item-by-item food log (`recent`: every logged item's name, calories, macros, ingredients). Each `recent` item's `id` works with update_log to correct mistakes.

tz_offset_min.description: The user's JS getTimezoneOffset() — minutes BEHIND UTC (e.g. 240 for EDT). Optional: when omitted, the user's app-reported timezone is used (UTC only if the account has never reported one).

name: get_today
